reason_for_addendum: R26.13 static audit found that question-only nearest-neighbor prediction reached about 91% factual field accuracy while the intended strong-model ceiling was 65%.
claim_rules: The frozen 12-field metric remains comparable with R26.9-R26.13 but cannot alone establish document-grounded factual ability.
A factual-difficulty claim must report all required factual metrics and the no-document baselines.
A five-level claim still requires the frozen unadjusted curve, the anchor-standardized curve, within-anchor direction counts and match-block bootstrap intervals.
No threshold may be changed after viewing an R26.14 provider result.
Sentinel5 screens protocol and large effects only; paper claims require Pilot20 from two strong model families.
